action: Request a machine-readable contractor-month ledger separating Class 1, Class 2, carryover, exchange, Section 215/uncontrolled-season, transfer and operational water. Cite the Table 22/23 files already assembled.

action: First audit the existing Millerton workbook and CDEC snapshots for coverage, units and missing observations. Obtain remaining Upper San Joaquin runoff/snow indicators and declare a drought reference period; preserve calendar-year versus water-year distinctions.

source: DWR SGMA Monitoring Network/CASGEM and USGS Water Services
action: Start with the packaged USGS depth observations and coverage table. Match repeated sites, status, dates and screen/datum metadata; seek missing DWR/USGS readings. Do not treat depth below land surface as hydraulic head or pumping.

dataset: Reported groundwater extraction and surface-water supply
action: Download annual-report workbooks for the Madera, Chowchilla, Kings, Kaweah, Tule and Kern subbasins; extract Part A groundwater extraction and Part C surface-water supply with method and spatial unit.
Use authorised OpenET access to request monthly/annual ensemble ET; check current access limits and archive request parameters. ET alone does not separate surface-water and groundwater supplies.
Download each available annual field layer; clip to the study area; harmonise crop classes and field IDs without treating fields as ownership parcels.

dataset: Farm rights, size, tenure and groundwater access
source: Friant contractors/districts or a primary survey under a data agreement
action: Request anonymised farm account/turnout records or field a survey. Public crop polygons and well points do not identify owners. Establish disclosure control and ethics approval before receipt.
